title: Bishara Mai Daɗi a Zamanin Tsofaffi
intro: Kana shaida lokacin da bege ke sake farfaɗowa. Wasu ma'aurata, waɗanda suka wuce zamanin iyaye, sun sami alƙawarin da ya saɓa wa dokokin yanayi. A tsakiyarsu akwai wani mutum wanda wanzuwarsa alama ce ta rahamar Allah - rai da aka ƙaddara don annabci, yana ɗauke da gadon da zai ɗauki tsararraki. Wanene wannan mutum mai ban mamaki?
clues: An haife ni ga iyaye waɗanda suka tsufa kuma ba su da 'ya'ya.
Mala'iku ne suka sanar da haihuwata, waɗanda suka zo a matsayin baƙi a gidana.
An ba ni hikima da annabci, kuma an ambace ni cikin masu haƙuri.
An kira mahaifina abokin Allah, kuma ni kyauta ce a gare shi a lokacin rayuwarsa ta ƙarshe.
Ina da ɗan'uwa wanda shi ma annabi ne, kuma Ubangijinmu ya albarkace mu duka.
Ɗana shi ma annabi ne, kuma an ba zuri'ata littafi da annabci.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: An haife su ga iyaye tsofaffi
An ba shi mulki da dukiya
Ya fitar da mutanensa daga Masar
Gina jirgi domin ceton masu bi
trial.answer: An haife su ga iyaye tsofaffi

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Ya zama annabi mai zuriyar annabawa
An halaka mutanensa saboda rashin imani
An ba shi ikon yin magana tun yana jariri
outcome.answer: Ya zama annabi mai zuriyar annabawa

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
